text:
AR460
Paradigms in Archaeology
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
A lecture
course
designed to introduce the
senior
student
to the major theoretical bases of the
discipline
of archaeology. This course will take a broad approach presenting data, ideas
and theories from across the archaeological spectrum. Emphasis will be placed on
developing an awareness of the use of theory in archaeological
research.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
AR101
,
AR102
.
Exclusions
AR360.
